mechanics.claim: Abduct's chain deals magic damage and stuns the first enemy hit, then Sylas dashes to them and knocks them up on arrival.
mechanics.quote: deal {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|standard sight|reveal}} and {{tip|stun|stun}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. Upon hitting the target, '''Sylas''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to their location and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds upon arrival.

mechanics.claim: Sylas cannot cast Chain Lash while the Abduct chains are in flight.
mechanics.quote: '''Sylas''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to cast {{ai|Chain Lash|Sylas}} while the chains are in flight.

mechanics.claim: Abduct counts as an ability activation for on-cast effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: ''Abduct'' counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: Sylas will not dash to the target if the chains are blocked by a spell shield.
mechanics.quote: '''Sylas''' will not dash to his target if the chains are blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}.

mechanics.claim: Kingslayer can be cast during the Abscond dash.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ai|Kingslayer|Sylas}} can be cast during the dash.''
